stories.headline: Russia resumes Kyiv strikes hours after US envoys leave; Zelensky calls peace ideas 'decent'

key_facts.fact: Russian airstrikes on Kyiv resumed on the morning of 8 September 2026, killing at least two people and wounding seven, ending a three-day pause both sides observed while US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner were in Moscow and Kyiv.
key_facts.excerpt: At least two people were killed by Russian airstrikes on Kyiv Tuesday morning, city authorities said, as Moscow resumed strikes on Ukraine following a visit by President Trump's envoys to both countries.

key_facts.fact: Volodymyr Zelensky said on 8 September that Witkoff and Kushner had presented several 'decent ideas' during the weekend talks, but that he did not yet know whether they could be made to work.
key_facts.excerpt: U.S. peace negotiators Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner presented several "decent ideas" during talks on how to end the war with Russia, Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelenskiy said on Tuesday.

key_facts.fact: Zelensky said he plans to meet Donald Trump later in September and wants to discuss a winter air-defence support package.
key_facts.excerpt: Zelenskiy told reporters in a WhatsApp media chat that he planned to meet U.S. President Donald Trump later in September and aimed to discuss a winter air defence support package.

key_facts.fact: Russia rejected a newly floated proposal for a truce in the air — either limited to energy infrastructure or halting all aerial strikes — and repeated its demand that Ukraine withdraw from Donbas.
key_facts.excerpt: Russia rejected a proposed truce in the air and repeated its demand that Ukraine leave Donbas when US envoys visited Moscow and Kyiv on September 5 and 6.

key_facts.fact: The overnight attack combined ballistic and cruise missiles with drones and damaged warehouses, a business centre, a metro station and shops across seven districts of Kyiv.
key_facts.excerpt: It ended within hours of their departure, with a combined ballistic, cruise and drone attack that killed two people and damaged warehouses, a business centre, a metro station and shops across seven districts of the capital.

key_facts.fact: Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov said on 7 September that Moscow does not rule out resuming trilateral Russia-US-Ukraine talks, but that it is too early to name a venue or dates.
key_facts.excerpt: "But it is too early to say anything about the venue or the exact dates at this stage," Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov told reporters.

key_facts.fact: Witkoff wrote on X that 'substantive progress' had been made, 'including movement on scheduling additional trilateral talks'; negotiators from Moscow and Kyiv last met in Geneva in February.
key_facts.excerpt: "Substantive progress was made, including movement on scheduling additional trilateral talks," US Special Envoy Steve Witkoff wrote on X.

stories.headline: GE Aerospace to buy castings maker CPP from Warburg Pincus and Berkshire for $11.75 billion

key_facts.fact: GE Aerospace announced on 8 September 2026 an agreement to acquire Consolidated Precision Products (CPP) for a cash purchase price of $11.75 billion, subject to closing adjustments.
key_facts.excerpt: On September 8, 2026, the Company issued a press release announcing the entry into an agreement to acquire Consolidated Precision Products ("CPP"), a leading manufacturer of highly engineered castings, for a cash purchase price of $11.75 billion, subject to closing adjustments.

key_facts.fact: CPP is being sold by private investment firms Warburg Pincus and Berkshire Partners; it was founded in 1991, is headquartered in Cleveland, Ohio, and has roughly 6,600 employees across more than 20 facilities.
key_facts.excerpt: GE Aerospace (NYSE:GE) announced today that it has signed an agreement to acquire Consolidated Precision Products (CPP), a leading manufacturer of highly engineered castings, from private investment firms Warburg Pincus and Berkshire Partners.

key_facts.fact: The deal will be financed with $7 billion in cash and the remainder in new debt, and values CPP at about 18x 2027 EBITDA including expected net synergies (about 26x without).
key_facts.excerpt: Purchase price of $11.75 billion to be financed with $7 billion in cash, with the remainder in new debt Values CPP at ~18x 2027 EBITDA including expected net synergies, multiple of ~26x without

key_facts.fact: CEO Larry Culp framed the purchase as securing casting capacity for simultaneous demand across commercial engines, aftermarket and defence; GE has been a CPP customer for over 15 years.
key_facts.excerpt: "Investing in mission-critical casting capacity is needed to support the strong simultaneous demand across commercial engines, aftermarket and defense."

key_facts.fact: The transaction is expected to close in the second half of 2027, subject to regulatory approvals, and GE expects it to be accretive to adjusted EPS and free cash flow in the first year.
key_facts.excerpt: The transaction is expected to close in the second half of 2027 and is subject to regulatory approvals and other customary closing conditions.

sources.title: GE Aerospace (NYSE: GE) plans takeover of key jet engine parts maker

stories.headline: Tamarack Valley and Headwater merge in C$10bn all-stock deal, extending Canada's oil-patch wave

key_facts.fact: Tamarack Valley Energy and Headwater Exploration announced on 8 September 2026 a definitive arrangement to merge in an all-stock transaction valued at C$10 billion.
key_facts.excerpt: Tamarack Valley Energy Ltd. (TSX: TVE) ("Tamarack") and Headwater Exploration Inc. (TSX: HWX) ("Headwater") are pleased to announce they have entered into a definitive arrangement agreement whereby the two companies will merge in an all-stock transaction valued at $10 billion.

key_facts.fact: Headwater shareholders receive one Tamarack share each, with Tamarack issuing 237.8 million shares; Tamarack holders will own 66.5% of the combined company and Headwater holders 33.5%.
key_facts.excerpt: Headwater shareholders will receive 1.0 common share of Tamarack for each Headwater common share held, resulting in Tamarack issuing a total of 237.8 million common shares

key_facts.fact: The combined company is expected to produce more than 80,000 barrels of oil equivalent per day from the Clearwater play, with net cash above C$50 million and available funding above C$1.2 billion.
key_facts.excerpt: expected to have run-rate pro forma Clearwater production of >80,000 boe per day (2), net cash (1) of >$50 million and available funding (1) of >$1.2 billion

key_facts.fact: Tamarack plans to raise its quarterly dividend 20%, from C$0.05 to C$0.06 per share, starting December 2026, and the deal spins out a separate exploration company, Tributary Exploration.
key_facts.excerpt: Tamarack plans to increase its quarterly dividend by 20% from $0.05 per share to $0.06 per share ($0.24 per share annualized), commencing December 2026.

key_facts.fact: Bloomberg valued the transaction at C$10 billion (about $7.24 billion) and described it as the latest in a wave of deals in Canada's oil patch.
key_facts.excerpt: Tamarack Valley Energy Ltd. agreed to buy Headwater Exploration Inc. for C$10 billion ($7.24 billion), the latest in a wave of deals in Canada's oil patch.

stories.headline: FDA clears AstraZeneca's camizestrant for breast cancer guided by a blood test for resistance

key_facts.fact: On 7 September 2026 the FDA granted accelerated approval to AstraZeneca's Etcamah (camizestrant) with a CDK4/6 inhibitor for adults with HR-positive, HER2-negative advanced breast cancer whose tumours develop an ESR1 mutation during first-line therapy.
key_facts.excerpt: Etcamah in combination with a CDK4/6 inhibitor approved in the US for 1st-line advanced HR-positive breast cancer

key_facts.fact: In the Phase III SERENA-6 trial the combination cut the risk of disease progression or death by 56% versus an aromatase inhibitor plus CDK4/6 inhibitor (hazard ratio 0.44; median progression-free survival 16.0 vs 9.2 months).
key_facts.excerpt: reduced the risk of disease progression or death by 56% versus standard-of-care treatment with an AI (anastrozole or letrozole) in combination with a CDK4/6 inhibitor (based on a hazard ratio [HR] of 0.44; ... median PFS 16.0 versus 9.2 months)

key_facts.fact: Time to second disease progression improved to a median 25.7 months versus 19.1 months; overall survival data remain immature.
key_facts.excerpt: a statistically significant and clinically meaningful PFS2 benefit of 25.7 months versus 19.1 months in favour of the Etcamah combination

key_facts.fact: The FDA simultaneously approved a companion diagnostic that detects emerging ESR1 resistance mutations in circulating tumour DNA; SERENA-6 is the first global registrational Phase III trial to use ctDNA blood monitoring to trigger a therapy switch before disease progresses.
key_facts.excerpt: the FDA also approved a companion diagnostic test to detect emerging ESR1 resistance mutations in the circulating tumour DNA (ctDNA) ... SERENA-6 is the first global, double-blind, registrational Phase III trial to use a ctDNA-guided approach

key_facts.fact: SERENA-6 enrolled 315 patients, testing ctDNA at routine scans every two to three months; about one in three patients with this form of advanced breast cancer develop ESR1 mutations before radiographic progression.
key_facts.excerpt: SERENA-6 enrolled 315 patients and used routine ctDNA blood testing at imaging visits every two to three months to detect emerging ESR1 resistance mutations.

stories.headline: Pharvaris oral pill cuts hereditary angioedema attacks 83% in pivotal Phase 3

key_facts.fact: Pharvaris announced on 8 September 2026 positive topline results from CHAPTER-3, the pivotal Phase 3 study of once-daily oral deucrictibant extended-release for preventing hereditary angioedema (HAE) attacks.
key_facts.excerpt: ZUG, Switzerland, Sept. 08, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Pharvaris (Nasdaq: PHVS) ... today announced statistically significant and clinically meaningful topline results of the CHAPTER-3 pivotal Phase 3 study

key_facts.fact: Deucrictibant XR reduced the mean monthly attack rate by 83% across all HAE types (p<0.0001), and by 87% in the 80 participants with HAE Type 1 or Type 2.
key_facts.excerpt: Treatment with deucrictibant XR in participants with all types of HAE reduced the mean monthly attack rate by 83% (p<0.0001).

key_facts.fact: The study randomised 85 participants from 21 countries 2:1 to deucrictibant XR 40 mg once daily or placebo for 24 weeks; the primary endpoint and all secondary efficacy endpoints were met with statistical significance.
key_facts.excerpt: The study randomized 85 participants from 21 countries in a 2:1 ratio to deucrictibant XR (N=55) or placebo (N=30) for 24 weeks of treatment.

key_facts.fact: CHAPTER-3 is the first Phase 3 prophylaxis study to evaluate all three HAE types, including patients with normal C1 inhibitor; protection appeared within the first week and was sustained through 24 weeks.
key_facts.excerpt: CHAPTER-3 is the first and only prophylaxis Phase 3 study to evaluate all three types of HAE, including people with HAE type 1, HAE type 2, or HAE with normal C1 inhibitor.

key_facts.fact: Pharvaris plans to file marketing authorisation applications starting in the first half of 2027, including a US New Drug Application.
key_facts.excerpt: Data from the CHAPTER-3 study will serve as the basis for marketing authorization applications, which are planned to be submitted starting in the first half of 2027.

sources.title: Pharvaris Announces Positive Topline Data from CHAPTER-3 Pivotal Study of Deucrictibant XR for Prophylaxis of HAE Attacks

stories.headline: Yen hits seven-month high as traders price a 60% chance the Fed hikes rates this month

key_facts.fact: The Japanese yen climbed to a fresh seven-month high against the dollar on 8 September 2026, reaching the 153 handle as traders unwound short positions on growing bets of a Bank of Japan rate hike.
key_facts.excerpt: The Japanese yen climbed to fresh seven-month highs against the U.S. dollar on Tuesday, as traders continued to unwind short positions amid growing bets of a Bank of Japan interest-rate hike

key_facts.fact: Futures markets priced roughly a 60% chance of a Federal Reserve rate hike at the 15-16 September FOMC meeting after a stronger-than-expected US payrolls report, with the dollar index at 98.83.
key_facts.excerpt: traders now pricing a roughly 60% chance of a Federal Reserve rate hike this month following Friday's stronger-than-expected nonfarm payrolls report.

key_facts.fact: US nonfarm payrolls rose 162,000 in August against expectations of about 56,000, unemployment held at 4.1%, and June and July were revised up by a combined 55,000.
key_facts.excerpt: non-farm payrolls increased by 162,000 in August, significantly higher than the market's previous estimate of approximately 56,000; the unemployment rate remained at 4.1%

key_facts.fact: Consensus for the 11 September US CPI report is core inflation up 0.2% month-on-month (2.4% year-on-year) and headline up 0.4% (3.4% year-on-year).
key_facts.excerpt: Market expectations, based on Reuters surveys, project core CPI up 0.2% month-over-month and 2.4% year-over-year; overall CPI expected up 0.4% month-over-month and 3.4% year-over-year.

key_facts.fact: The ECB meets on 10 September and is expected by all 65 economists in a Reuters poll to raise its deposit rate 25 basis points to 2.50%, after eurozone inflation jumped to 3.3% in August — the highest since September 2023 — driven by a 14.3% year-on-year rise in energy prices tied to the Iran conflict.
key_facts.excerpt: Eurostat data shows that the Eurozone's Harmonized Index of Consumer Prices (HICP) is expected to rise 3.3% year-on-year in August, up from 2.9% in July, reaching its highest level since September 2023. Energy prices rose 14.3% year-on-year

key_facts.fact: Oil sat near a six-week high amid Iranian retaliation threats, one of the forces pushing central banks in the US and Europe back toward tightening.
key_facts.excerpt: Oil near six-week high amid Iran retaliation threats

stories.headline: Attacker drains 4,000 BTC from Blockstream's Liquid Network, then returns 3,400 after patch

key_facts.fact: Liquid Network said on 6 September 2026 that roughly 4,000 BTC — then worth about $320 million — had been withdrawn from its federation wallet, and paused network activity while urging exchanges to suspend LBTC deposits and withdrawals.
key_facts.excerpt: Communication between the parties began after Liquid said on Sept. 6 that roughly 4,000 BTC, then worth about $320 million, had been withdrawn from its federation wallet.

key_facts.fact: On 7 September the attacker returned 3,400 BTC — about 85% of the funds — after Blockstream said its bridge nodes had been patched, keeping roughly 598.5 BTC ($47.3 million).
key_facts.excerpt: The attacker then returned 3,400 BTC to the federation address in block 965,950, leaving about 598.5 BTC ($47.3 million) in the attacker's wallet.

key_facts.fact: The two sides negotiated on-chain: the self-described white-hat used Bitcoin OP_RETURN messages and PGP-encrypted text, telling Blockstream to 'fix the bug first' before returning funds; Adam Back-led Blockstream replied with a PGP-signed on-chain message saying 'Bridge nodes are patched, safe to return the funds.'
key_facts.excerpt: The purported white-hat hacker communicated with Blockstream through Bitcoin OP_RETURN messages and PGP-encrypted text.

key_facts.fact: The funds moved through SideSwap's Peg-out Authorization Key, but that key was not compromised; Blockstream established the LBTC had been created through a bug in the Elements software.
key_facts.excerpt: Blockstream later established that the LBTC had been created through a bug in the Elements software, according to SideSwap.

key_facts.fact: Liquid is a Bitcoin sidechain used by exchanges; the federation had held about 4,200 BTC in the affected wallet.
key_facts.excerpt: Bitcoin network used by exchanges hit by $320 million exploit; hackers claim they're the good guys
